qualifier: meiotic and mitotic, including meiotic recombination and synapsis
name: Meiotic and mitotic chromosome cohesion, condensation and segregation
rationale: Members cover sister chromatid cohesion, chromosome condensation, centromeric CENP-A chromatin and spindle-driven segregation in both divisions, and unlike the mitotic-exit, nuclear-envelope and chromatin-assembly confusables the theme carries the meiotic programme (recombination, synapsis, chiasmata, meiosis I regulation).

qualifier: packaging, positive capping and replication
name: Telomere packaging, capping and replication-associated maintenance
rationale: All members concern telomere end maintenance (packaging, semi-conservative replication, D-loop and t-circle control, capping), and the theme is distinguished from confusables centred on capping inhibition, NHEJ protection and recombination-based maintenance by its telomere packaging and positive capping members.

qualifier: synthesis, salvage and catabolism
name: Pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotide synthesis, salvage and catabolism
rationale: Members span de novo synthesis, salvage and breakdown of pyrimidine nucleotides plus deoxyribonucleotide (including dAMP/dGMP) metabolism, separating the theme from confusables on nucleotide di/triphosphate interconversion, purine ribonucleotide synthesis and purine deoxynucleoside catabolism.

qualifier: metalloproteinase-mediated collagen and elastin breakdown
name: Metalloproteinase-mediated collagen and elastin degradation and its regulation
rationale: Members cover MMP activation, collagen and elastin catabolism and the control of peptidase activity and matrix disassembly, distinguishing the theme from collagen synthesis/elastic fibre assembly and coagulation/fibrinolysis confusables.

qualifier: ductal branching and epithelial lineages
name: Mammary gland ductal branching and epithelial lineage development
rationale: All members concern mammary development via duct branching/elongation, thelarche and stem, luminal, myoepithelial and alveolar cell lineages, unlike confusables centred on lactation, alveolar development, involution or prostate and reproductive tract development.

qualifier: endogenous danger ligands (heme, oxidised LDL) and SIRP-mediated restraint
name: Monocyte inflammatory signaling to endogenous ligands with SIRP restraint
rationale: Members describe myeloid inflammatory and TLR signaling triggered by endogenous ligands such as heme and oxidised LDL together with SIRP-mediated inhibition of phagocytosis and neutrophil activation, which separates it from confusables on bacterial LPS/lipopeptide sensing, antigen presentation and Fc receptor/neutrophil effector programmes.

qualifier: stress- and oncogene-induced, with heterochromatin and Polycomb silencing
name: Stress- and oncogene-induced senescence with heterochromatin silencing
rationale: All members concern entry into and regulation of senescence (oncogene, oxidative, replicative), its SASP and its chromatin basis (SAHF, Polycomb BMI1 modules), whereas confusables centre on cancer evasion of senescence via p16/p14ARF defects or p53 DNA-damage and UV responses.

qualifier: receptor endocytosis, recycling and endosomal iron export
name: Transferrin-mediated iron uptake and recycling
rationale: The three members describe transferrin endocytosis/recycling and the endosomal DMT1 iron transport step it feeds, setting the theme apart from confusables on plasma-membrane iron import, heme scavenging and copper/manganese handling.

qualifier: oxidation and acetylation of plant-derived and aromatic compounds
name: Xenobiotic oxidation and acetylation, including plant-derived compounds
rationale: Members cover phase I oxidative (demethylation, aromatic amine N-hydroxylation) and acetylation detoxification of xenobiotics including phenylpropanoids, monoterpenoids and alkaloids, unlike confusables based on FMO oxidation, methylation, sulfonation or steroid metabolism.

qualifier: Sema4D and RND1 GTPase
name: Sema4D-plexin signaling via RND1 GTPase
rationale: All members describe semaphorin-plexin signaling, with Sema4D-driven migration inhibition/growth-cone collapse and the RND1 cycle distinguishing it from Sema3A axon-repulsion, RND2/3 and G12/13-Rho confusables.

qualifier: mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition and tubule epithelial differentiation
name: Metanephric mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition and nephron tubule epithelial differentiation
rationale: The three members concern conversion of metanephric mesenchyme into nephron tubule epithelium, distinguishing the theme from confusables on ureteric bud/nephric duct development and comma/S-shaped body morphogenesis.

qualifier: combined T and B cell
name: T and B lymphocyte development and activation
rationale: Members jointly cover thymocyte and T cell differentiation/costimulation and B cell proliferation and differentiation, distinguishing the theme from confusables restricted to early B lineage commitment, mature B cell modules or T cell activation alone.

qualifier: NER gap filling and error-free POLH translesion synthesis
name: Excision-repair gap filling and error-free POLH translesion synthesis
rationale: Members concern post-incision repair synthesis in nucleotide excision repair and error-free translesion synthesis by POLH, separating the theme from NER damage recognition/incision and from base-excision repair and error-prone TLS confusables.

core: Fibronectin matrix adhesion and actin stress fibers
qualifier: fibroblast migration
name: Fibronectin matrix adhesion driving stress fibers and fibroblast migration
rationale: Members link fibronectin matrix formation, syndecan and integrin adhesion to SRF-driven cytoskeletal remodelling, stress fiber assembly and fibroblast migration, unlike confusables on focal adhesion turnover, invadopodia, ROCK/PAK signaling or MET-PTK2 signaling.

qualifier: neuronal vesicles, mitochondria and endolysosomes
name: Motor-driven transport of neuronal vesicles, mitochondria and endolysosomes
rationale: All members concern cytoskeletal motor transport and positioning of organelles, including axo-dendritic vesicle and receptor transport, Miro-dependent mitochondrial transport and endosome/lysosome sizing, distinguishing it from tubulin-modification, microtubule-severing, clathrin-cycle and ER-network confusables.

qualifier: to UV, nitric oxide and mitogens
name: AP-1 immediate-early response to UV, nitric oxide and mitogens
rationale: Members centre on AP-1/FOS-family immediate-early transcription induced by UV, nitric oxide, phorbol ester, KRAS and growth factors, while confusables focus on MAPK negative feedback, TAK1-JNK/p38 kinase activation or monocyte chemokine signaling.

qualifier: ribbon disassembly, reassembly and positioning
name: Golgi ribbon disassembly, reassembly and positioning
rationale: All members concern the architecture of the Golgi (ribbon formation, mitotic disassembly/reassembly, pericentriolar positioning), distinguishing the theme from confusables on intra-Golgi vesicle traffic, secretion and Rho-family GTPase cycles.

qualifier: with iodide and thyroid hormone transport
name: Neutral amino acid, iodide and thyroid hormone transport
rationale: Members cover membrane transport of large and small neutral amino acids alongside thyroid hormone and iodide transport and thyroid hormone generation, the thyroid component separating it from confusables on cationic amino acid, polyamine and inositol transport.

qualifier: AIM2 and NLRC4 inflammasomes
name: Pyroptosis via AIM2 and NLRC4 inflammasomes
rationale: All members concern pyroptotic cell death and the AIM2 and IPAF/NLRC4 inflammasomes that trigger it, distinguishing the theme from NLRP1/NLRP3-IL-1/IL-18 and caspase-4/5 noncanonical inflammasome confusables.

qualifier: Rho GTPase activation of WASP/WAVE for lamellipodia
name: WASP/WAVE-Arp2/3 actin nucleation driving lamellipodium assembly
rationale: The three members describe Rho GTPase activation of WASP/WAVE proteins to nucleate Arp2/3 branched actin for lamellipodia, distinguishing it from confusables on leading-edge regulation, Fc-gamma phagocytic cup formation and Rac/RhoG GTPase cycles.

qualifier: maternal mRNA clearance at the maternal-to-zygotic transition
name: Deadenylation-dependent mRNA decay in maternal mRNA clearance
rationale: Members combine poly(A) shortening, deadenylation-dependent decay and P-body assembly with M- and Z-decay of maternal transcripts, separating it from miRNA/RBP-mediated decay, MZT chromatin/zygotic genome activation, and nuclear RNA surveillance confusables.

qualifier: intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct and metanephric mesenchyme
name: Early kidney development from intermediate mesoderm to nephron epithelium
rationale: Members trace early nephrogenesis from intermediate mesoderm and nephric duct through metanephric mesenchyme maintenance, renal vesicle formation and tubule epithelial differentiation, unlike confusables on kidney size control or comma/S-shaped body morphogenesis.

qualifier: brown and beige differentiation and cold-induced thermogenesis
name: Brown and beige adipocyte differentiation and cold-induced thermogenesis
rationale: Members cover brown/beige fat differentiation, cold and diet-induced thermogenesis, PGC-1alpha activation and fatty acid cycling/uncoupling, distinguishing the theme from white adipogenesis, lipogenic transcription and lipid droplet/lipolysis confusables.

qualifier: lipase-mediated
name: Lipase-mediated plasma lipoprotein remodeling and clearance
rationale: Members describe lipase-driven remodeling and receptor clearance of chylomicrons, VLDL, LDL and HDL with associated triglyceride and phospholipid hydrolysis, unlike confusables on intestinal lipid absorption, lipoprotein assembly or LXR-driven lipogenesis.

qualifier: oligodendrocyte, Schwann cell and astrocyte differentiation
name: Glial differentiation, proliferation and myelination in CNS and PNS
rationale: Members concern glial fate, proliferation and differentiation of oligodendrocytes, Schwann cells and astrocytes plus CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance, distinguishing it from axon regeneration/sprouting and node-of-Ranvier assembly confusables.
